definitions.explanation: The result obtained by adding quantities together and dividing the total by the number of quantities.

examples.japanese: {平均|へいきん}{点|てん}は75{点|てん}だった。
{日本人|にほんじん}の{平均|へいきん}{寿命|じゅみょう}は{長|なが}い。
examples.english: The average lifespan of Japanese people is long.

examples.japanese: {平均|へいきん}して{一日|いちにち}8{時間|じかん}{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: On average, I work 8 hours a day.

notes:
{平均|へいきん} is composed of {平|へい} (flat/even) + {均|きん} (equal).

COMMON USES:
- {平均|へいきん}{点|てん}: average score
- {平均|へいきん}{気温|きおん}: average temperature
- {平均|へいきん}{寿命|じゅみょう}: average lifespan
- {平均|へいきん}{収入|しゅうにゅう}: average income
- {平均|へいきん}{値|ち}: average value
- {平均|へいきん}して: on average
- {平均|へいきん}を{上回|うわまわ}る: to exceed the average
